unmapped_findings: C22000 brass (commercial bronze) twin grain is one of six additional micrographs in the extended experiments; these image samples are not provided with corresponding annotations.

MatSAM, prompted by structure-aware points, segments nearly all the mentioned phases in the C22000 twin grain image; the binary mask result of the twin-grain ROIs is precisely separated in the Key structure column of Fig. 10.

A brass micrograph in Fig. 11(b) (not explicitly labelled C22000) illustrates post-processing for twin-grain filtering: parameters such as circularity, contour geometry, area, and grayscale range are calculated for each mask, and tailored filtering conditions distinguish elongated twin grains.
